# typename-substitutions.txt
# Passed to `dotnet xscgen --tnsf` to clean up auto-generated C# type names.
# Rules:
#   A) Top-level <X>Type   -> <X>            (e.g. ProjectType -> Project)
#   B) Set container <X>SetType -> <X>Set    (same shape as A)
#   C) Type<X>             -> <X>            (enum prefixes, e.g. TypeIlluminaModel -> IlluminaModel)
#       special: Type454Model -> Model454    (digit-prefix would be invalid)
#   D) Child <Parent>Type<...> -> <Parent><...>  (mechanical infix strip)
#
# Skipped (would collide with an existing distinct class):
#   EntrySetType (anonymous root EntrySet already exists)
#   TaxonSetType (anonymous root TaxonSet already exists)
#   IdExtIdType  (sibling IdExtId already exists)
#
# Regenerated by `build.cmd regenerateInsdcTypes` (see build/BasicTasks.fs).
# Hand-edit to override a single rename; lines starting with # are ignored.
